summary: Temporary restricted area for drones only near Loch Goil, Scotland, up to 3,100 feet above mean sea level, with some exemptions.
text:
RESTRICTED AREA (TEMPORARY) INSTALLED FOR UAS ONLY (LOCH GOIL,
SCOTLAND). WI AREA BOUNDED BY: 561015.69N 0045555.15W - 
561044.69N 0045340.34W - 560547.85N 0045056.59W - 
560528.07N 0045114.15W - THEN ANTI-CLOCKWISE ARC OF A CIRCLE RADIUS 
2NM CENTRED 560331.00N 0045159.00W TO 560445.91N 0045446.04W - 
561015.69N 0045555.15W. DOES NOT APPLY TO ANY UAS FLYING IN 
ACCORDANCE WITH THE PERMISSION OF HIS MAJESTYS NAVAL BASE CLYDE DUTY 
NAVAL BASE OFFICER OR HIS MAJESTYS NAVAL BASE CLYDE JOINT OPERATIONS 
CENTRE CTC TEL 01436-674321 EXTENSION 1 THEN 5318 OR 07879-200661 
(OUT OF HOURS ONLY). RESTRICTION OF FLYING REGULATIONS MADE UNDER 
ARTICLE 239 OF THE AIR NAV ORDER 2016. AR-2026-10982/01.
